title: deepclaude: a drop-in rerouter that runs Claude Code's entire tool loop on DeepSeek V4 Pro instead
description:
Claude Code is an amazing autonomous CLI but running it constantly costs a fortune in Anthropic API fees. deepclaude lets you swap out the brain while keeping the exact same user experience. Reroutes the Claude Code tool loop to use the incredibly cheap DeepSeek V4 Pro model instead. Same bash execution, same file editing, same sub-agent spawning. 17x cost reduction.

https://github.com/aattaran/deepclaude
